faqItems.question: How can AI match an experienced scout?
faqItems.answer: It doesn't replace your scouts — it eliminates the 80% of their work that isn't judgment. Your scouts spend most of their time filtering databases and building spreadsheets. ScoutCopilot handles that pre-screening phase in seconds so your scouts apply their judgment to a pre-filtered shortlist instead of grinding through 500 players.

faqItems.question: We already have Wyscout — why pay more?
faqItems.answer: You're paying thousands per year for data access but querying it through manual filters and Excel exports. ScoutCopilot is the AI layer that turns your existing data investment into a competitive advantage — natural language queries, tactical fit analysis, and development trajectory predictions that no current Wyscout interface provides.

faqItems.question: What if the AI makes mistakes?
faqItems.answer: Every recommendation shows the underlying data and ranking rationale — no black box. The tool is an assistant, not an authority: it generates shortlists, your team makes decisions. At the Club tier, custom models learn your club's specific philosophy over time.

faqItems.question: Is our data secure?
faqItems.answer: Your API credentials are stored in Supabase Vault with AES-256-GCM encryption. All API calls execute server-side using your credentials. We never store or cache player data beyond your active session. Your data never leaves your account.

faqItems.question: Can we try before committing?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Start with a 14-day free trial on any plan — no credit card required. Plus every paid plan comes with a 30-day money-back guarantee, no questions asked.

dataSources.heading: Data Sources
dataSources.description: ScoutCopilot aggregates player data from multiple sources to build comprehensive profiles.
dataSources.statsbombOpen: Free open dataset with 50+ statistical metrics per player across major competitions.
dataSources.apiFootball: Supplementary data including player photos, squad details, and league metadata.

dataSources.statsbombApi: Premium advanced statistics. Requires your own StatsBomb API credentials.

search.heading: How Search Works
search.description: Search uses AI to translate your natural language queries into structured player filters and rankings.
search.step1: Your natural language query is parsed by Claude AI into structured filters (position, age range, league, play style, etc.).
search.step2: Matching players are retrieved from the database based on these structured filters.
search.step3: Claude AI ranks each matching player with a fit_score (0–100) based on how well they match your specific requirements.
search.fitScoreDescription: Purely AI-determined. The model evaluates each player's statistical profile against your query criteria to produce a relevance score.
search.fallbackDescription: When the AI service is unavailable, all matching players receive a default fit_score of 70 so search results remain functional.

reports.heading: How Reports Work
reports.description: Player statistics are fed to Claude AI, which generates a professional scouting analysis report.
reports.strengths: Strengths and weaknesses are identified and backed by specific statistical evidence.
reports.style: Style of play is inferred from statistical patterns (e.g., high progressive passes = creative playmaker).
reports.ratings: Category ratings (A/B/C/D) are assigned for attacking, defending, passing, and physical attributes.
reports.recommendation: The recommendation includes tactical system fit and suggested roles within formations.

comparisons.heading: How Comparisons Work
comparisons.description: Multiple players' statistics are analyzed side-by-side by Claude AI for head-to-head evaluation.
comparisons.perMetric: Per-metric ranking highlights which player leads in each statistical category.
comparisons.narrative: A comparative narrative provides context with specific stat references and trade-off analysis.

limitations.heading: Limitations & Transparency
limitations.errors: AI may make errors in analysis. Always verify key findings with video analysis and your own scouting judgment.
limitations.relative: Fit scores are relative to your search query, not absolute player quality ratings.
limitations.model: Model: Claude 3 Haiku — optimized for speed and cost-effectiveness in high-volume scouting workflows.
limitations.noWeights: Scoring weights influence AI evaluations but are not deterministic. The AI model applies its own reasoning on top of your configured preferences.
